hero_section.introduction: I'm Bbosa Muhamood, a Fullstack Web Developer
hero_section.description: Entrepreneur and fullstack freelance Typescript developer at your service

services_section.title: Custom Web Applications and Websites Development
services_section.description: The services I offer include traditional development for more flexibility, no-code solutions with Webflow for simplicity and speed, and natural SEO.

web_development.title: Website or Web Application Development
web_development.description: Development based on a given graphic design or one we can create together to turn it into a web project. I pay special attention to UX, optimization, and web accessibility. I develop landing pages, blogs, portfolios, showcase sites, and web applications (SaaS, etc.).

seo.title: Google SEO
seo.description: Optimization of your website/web app for organic search engine ranking on Google and other search engines—SEO.

web_design.title: Web Design
web_design.description: Creating your design and branding on Figma, with a wireframe and mockup phase, or directly on Webflow.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Audit and improvement of your website's accessibility, following WCAG standards.

experience_section.title: My Experience
experience_section.description: A former paratrooper passionate about the web and entrepreneurship, I retrained as a freelance web developer. I also develop my own software, including LinkerFlow, my current project.

experiences.title: LinkerFlow, SaaS Webflow Tool
experiences.description: I developed LinkerFlow, a Webflow tool to automate internal linking—a time-consuming but crucial method for SEO.

experiences.title: JS Developer Training, Wild Code School
experiences.description: I completed an intensive 5-month training (February to July 2024) as a web developer where I learned technologies like React / Express / Node.js / MySQL / Git and Github, as well as web accessibility, Agile methods like Scrum, and teamwork through multiple projects.

experiences.title: No Code Agency, My Webflow Agency
experiences.description: From late 2023 to 2024, I worked hard to find clients as a freelance Webflow developer. I put my SEO skills to work to grow my own Webflow Agency website (No Code Agency), which I now manage with freelance partners.

experiences.title: Spylead, Tech Product Listing Site
experiences.description: Together with a partner, we developed Spylead on Webflow—a site listing tech products like Google Maps scrapers, IP address providers, etc.

experiences.title: Freelance Webflow Developer
experiences.description: After my previous job, I decided to retrain in web development. I self-trained in Webflow and began offering my services as a freelance Webflow developer.

experiences.title: Paratrooper Rifleman, Air Force
experiences.description: After over a year in the reserves, I enlisted as a pilot trainee in the Air Force in 2017. Wanting more action and physical work, I changed specialties and joined the paratrooper riflemen, completing numerous training courses over more than 6 years of service.

technologies_section.title: Future Technologies I Master
technologies_section.description: All the programming languages, libraries, and frameworks—code and no-code—that I know and offer in my services. I'm also open to learning and discovering new techs for your project!

projects_section.title: Awesome Projects I’ve Built
projects_section.description: Projects I built during training, for myself, and as a freelancer

contact.description: Whether you're a business, a freelancer, or just curious about web development, feel free to contact me. You can reach me by email or through the form, and I’ll respond as soon as possible!
